node.name: Dynamics 365 & Power Platform UK User Groups
node.description:
## Our community

User groups having been running in the UK for over 10 years, starting with a user group for Dynamics CRM in 2011.

Since then, we have expanded in number and in scope, covering not just the traditional ‘CRM’ applications under Dynamics 365 but also the Microsoft Power Platform – Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and Power Virtual Agents.

Our user groups provide an opportunity for users of Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform to get together, share their knowledge and get to know each other in a fun, open, and welcoming environment. Whatever your level of experience or how long you’ve been using the products, you’re welcome to our free meetings!

### Topics

The user group meetings cover all topics under the Dynamics 365 and Power Platform umbrella. We have talks on technical subjects such as development and solution architecture but also cover business perspectives as well, such as user adoption, managing change and business analysis.

### National user group

Our flagship all-day user groups – what we call the 'National' user groups – run several free all-day events per year. Each event offers 15+ sessions and typically attracts an audience of 150+ people. The events are held either in central London or Manchester.

### Regional user groups

Our regional user groups cover many areas of the UK. These meetings are typically held in the evening after a working day and have 2 or 3 speakers on topics related to Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform.

node.name: Women on the Rise Meetup Group
node.description:
Women on the RISE AI is a global movement and AI-powered platform designed to help women Lift, RISE, and SOAR—at every stage of their career journey.

✨ LIFT supports women in career transition—whether returning to work, changing industries, or navigating redundancy—by using AI-driven insights, coaching, and skills mapping to guide them into the right next role, not just the next available one.

🔥 RISE empowers women inside corporate roles to grow with confidence, visibility, and strategic clarity. Our AI helps women stay role-ready, promotion-ready, and future-ready—building leadership capability, negotiating power, and resilience in fast-changing workplaces.

🚀 SOAR is built for women entrepreneurs and founders who want to scale. From go-to-market strategy and revenue growth to decision support and execution, AI becomes a co-pilot for sustainable business growth—without burnout.

At the heart of Women on the RISE AI is a commitment to ethical, human-centred AI. We actively work to combat gender bias in technology and raise awareness of emerging threats such as deepfake gender-based crime, equipping women with knowledge, tools, and protection in the digital age.

This isn’t about replacing human potential—it’s about amplifying it.

Women on the RISE AI exists so women don’t just survive change—they lead it.

💜 Lift. Rise. Soar. With AI on your side.

This group is for women in Tech, Data, AML, Crypto, Financial services or Insurance to network, empower each other and RISE together.

We partner as volunteer project in conjunction with Rahab’s Daughters a charity. We also fight human trafficking together!

Learn more www.wotrai.com and become a full member.

node.name: Tech Startups in the Pub - Relaxed Networking
node.description:
# 🍻 Tech Startups in the Pub – London & Lagos Editions 🚀

While many co-working spaces run events for their members, and plenty of talks cater to specific roles or stages, we wanted something different: a casual, open meetup where **anyone connected to startups can feel at home**.

You could be exploring the idea of founding a startup for the very first time, or already a seasoned operator with stories to share, **everyone’s welcome**.

What makes Tech Startups in the Pub work is the mix, early-stage dreamers, experienced founders, product folks, engineers, investors, and community builders all in the same room, swapping stories and ideas. The conversations are relaxed, peer-to-peer, and often spark unexpected connections. Whatever your background, you’ll find people you can learn from and people who can learn from you.

We’re excited to share that the community is now **running in three flavours**:

* **London** → Now twice a month:
    * **1st Wednesday** at Simmons Bar, Oxford Street
    * **3rd Friday** at The Windmill, Shoreditch
* **Lagos, Nigeria** → Every **3rd Thursday** at The Nest Lounge, hosted by Alfred and CC

👉 **What to expect:**

* A friendly, welcoming crowd of founders, operators, and startup enthusiasts
* Wristbands from the hosts in London so you know who’s part of the group
* Reserved space in Lagos so it’s easy to find everyone
* Zero hard selling, zero pressure — just genuine connections

📍 **Venues**

* **London – Oxford Street:** Simmons Bar, 203 Wardour St, W1F 8ZH (1st Wednesday, from 6 PM)
* **London – Shoreditch:** The Windmill, 27 Tabernacle St, EC2A 4DE (3rd Friday, from 6 PM)
* **Lagos – The Nest Lounge:** (3rd Thursday, from 6 PM)

**House Rules**

* Say hi to the hosts (Oliver, Pedro, Rob, Rob in London; Alfred & CC in Lagos) and grab a wristband/intro.
* No hard selling or heavy pitching — this is about building community.
* Not drinking? No problem — come for the people and conversation.

Mark your calendar, bring your curiosity, and come join the community. See you soon! 🍻

node.name: PyData London Meetup
node.description:
[london.pydata.org](https://london.pydata.org)

Submit a talk: [https://london.pydata.org/submit-a-talk/](https://london.pydata.org/submit-a-talk/)

PyData is an educational program of NumFOCUS, a 501(c)3 non-profit organization in the United States. PyData provides a forum for the international community of users and developers of data analysis tools to share ideas and learn from each other. The global PyData network promotes discussion of best practices, new approaches, and emerging technologies for data management, processing, analytics, and visualization. PyData communities approach data science using many languages, including (but not limited to) Python, Julia, and R.

The PyData [Code of Conduct ](http://pydata.org/code-of-conduct.html)governs this meetup. To discuss any issues or concerns relating to the code of conduct or the behavior of anyone at a PyData meetup, please contact NumFOCUS Executive Director Leah Silen (+1 512-222-5449; [leah@numfocus.org](mailto:leah@numfocus.org)) or the group organizer.

node.name: Agentic AI London
node.description:
Welcome to the Agentic AI London meet up group!

Agents no longer simply execute predefined instructions... they plan, reason, make autonomous decisions, and adapt their behaviour dynamically in response to changing environments.

In this meetup series, we will host regular, AI-focused events exploring the rapidly evolving landscape of agentic systems. Sessions will cover topics such as:

* **Foundations of Agentic AI** \- definitions\, core capabilities\, and architectural paradigms
* **Autonomy & Decision-Making** \- planning\, reasoning loops\, goal\-directed behaviour\, and multi\-agent coordination
* **Operational Considerations** \- deployment\, orchestration\, monitoring\, and real\-world reliability
* **Risks, Challenges, and Opportunities** \- safety concerns\, failure modes\, governance\, and high impact applications
* **Current Research** \- state of the art methods\, evaluation frameworks\, and emerging trends
* **AI Engineering** \- building\, scaling\, and integrating agentic systems into products and workflows
* **Data Science & Intelligence Workflows** \- data\-driven optimisation\, feedback loops\, and continual learning

Organised and run by Rhys Davies

node.name: LLM Reading Club
node.description:
The LLM Reading Club is for anyone interested in building both a theoretical intuition of large language models and practical expertise in their development and use. There’s momentum and fun in numbers! 😊 The club will collectively explore some of the canonical books and research papers pertaining to large language models.

The level of prerequisite knowledge needed to maximise benefit will vary depending on the specific book or paper being covered. Generally, the content will be most suitable for those proficient in Python and with some understanding of (or a willingness to quickly learn) the relevant core machine learning or mathematical concepts.

**All** are welcome - this includes but not limited to - data practitioners of all hues, enthusiasts, students, researchers, and professionals.
